title: Chemically defined generation of human definitive hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells
protocol: Transfer 32 mL of ice-cold DMEM/F-12 medium into a 50 mL conical tube.
Place an aliquot of Matrigel solution on ice after removing it from the −80°C freezer.
Transfer Matrigel into DMEM/F-12 medium using a P1000 pipette.
Gently mix the Matrigel and DMEM/F-12 medium with a 10 mL pipette.
Add 1 mL of Matrigel solution to each well of a 6-well plate.
Add 0.5 mL of Matrigel solution to each well of a 12-well plate.
Add 0.25 mL of Matrigel solution to each well of a 24-well plate using a P1000 pipette.
Gently shake the plates to ensure the Matrigel solution fully covers the surface of the wells.
Place coated plates in a humidified incubator at 37°C for at least 30 minutes before cell culture.
Add extra DMEM/F-12 medium (0.5–1 mL) to prevent drying out 2–3 days after coating.
Refill each well with 1–2 mL of DMEM/F-12 medium every 3–7 days as needed.
Warm mTeSR Plus medium at room temperature for approximately 30 min.
Transfer 5 mL of mTeSR Plus to a 15 mL conical tube using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Remove a frozen cell cryovial of human pluripotent stem cells from a liquid nitrogen tank.
Immerse the cryovial in a 37°C water bath without submerging the cap.
Gently swirl the cryovial for 2–3 min until the contents are completely thawed.
Spray the cryovial with 70% ethanol before placing it into a biosafety tissue culture cabinet.
Transfer cell mixture from the cryovial to a sterile 15 mL conical tube containing 5 mL of prewarmed mTeSR Plus medium using a P1000 pipette.
Centrifuge the cell mixture at 200 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant from the 15-mL tube via vacuum aspiration.
Remove Matrigel solution from the coated plate by P1000 pipette or vacuum aspiration.
Gently resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL of mTeSR Plus medium containing 5 μM Y27632 by P1000 pipette.
Transfer cells into an empty Matrigel-coated well using P1000 pipette.
Label plates with hPSC line, passage number, data frozen, data thawed, and initials.
Return the plate to the incubator (humidified, 5% CO2, 37°C).
Gently shake the plate back and forth for a few times to evenly distribute the cells.
Warm mTeSR Plus medium at room temperature for approximately 30 min.
Aspirate old medium from each well of hPSC-containing 6-well plate.
Replace with 2 mL of fresh prewarmed mTeSR Plus medium.
Repeat this step daily until cells are ready for passaging (∼80%–90% confluency).
Warm mTeSR Plus medium at room temperature for approximately 30 minutes.
Aspirate the old medium from each well of hPSC-containing 6-well plate.
Add 1 mL of room temperature Versene to each well.
Incubate the plate in an incubator (humidified, 5% CO2, 37°C) for 5 minutes.
If cells do not detach easily after 5 minutes, leave plates longer (e.g., 7–10 minutes).
If cells detach easily from the bottom, incubate the plate for less than 5 minutes (e.g., 3 or 4 minutes).
During Versene incubation, add 2 mL of mTeSR Plus medium with 5 μM Y27632 into a new Matrigel-coated well after aspirating Matrigel solution.
Aspirate the Versene from the hPSC-containing plate.

Collect 1 mL of medium using a P1000 pipette and dispense this medium over the surface of the hPSC-containing well treated with Versene until all colonies are detached (∼3 or 4 times) under a microscope with a 10× objective.
After most cells (over 90% cells) are detached, gently pipette to mix the cell mixture using a P1000 pipette.
Transfer ∼160 μL of the cell suspension to the new Matrigel-coated well at a ratio of 1:6.
Return the plate to the incubator after plating the cells.
Gently shake the plate in 3 quick, short, back- and front- and side-to-side motions to evenly disperse the cell across the surface of the wells.
Warm mTeSR Plus medium at room temperature for approximately 30 minutes.
Aspirate the old medium from stem cell culture plate via vacuum aspiration.
Add 1 mL of Accutase to the same well using a P1000 pipette.
Incubate the plate at 37°C, 5% CO2, and humidified conditions for 5 minutes.
Gently pipette to dissociate all cells from the surface with a P1000 pipette.
Manually count the cells in a cell hemocytometer.
Transfer 5 × 10^7 cells (approximately one-third of the cell suspension) to a 15-mL conical tube containing 2 mL of mTeSR Plus as a quenching medium.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend the cells in 12 mL of mTeSR Plus medium containing 5 μM Y27632 and 0.5 μg/mL iMatrix-511 using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Transfer 0.5 mL of the cell mixture into each well of a 24-well plate using a P1000 pipette or 5 mL serological pipette.
Place the plate with cells in an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, and humidified conditions.
Gently shake the plate back and forth for 2 to 3 times to evenly distribute the cells.
Prepare a conical tube with 12 mL of DMEM/Vc medium containing 6 μM CHIR99021.
Aspirate the old mTeSR plus medium via vacuum aspiration.
Transfer 0.5 mL of DMEM/Vc with CHIR99021 to each well of the 24-well plate using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Record the time when CHIR99021 is added.
Return the plate to the incubator (37°C,  5% CO2, humidified).
Warm LaSR Basal medium in a 37°C water bath for approximately 30 minutes on Day 1.
Aspirate the old DMEM/Vc medium via vacuum aspiration.
Transfer 0.5 mL of LaSR Basal medium to each well of the plate using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Return the plate to the cell culture incubator (37°C,  5% CO2, humidified).
Warm LaSR Basal medium in a 37°C water bath for approximately 30 minutes on Day 2.
Prepare a conical tube with 12 mL of LaSR Basal medium containing 50 ng/mL VEGF.
Aspirate the old medium via vacuum aspiration.
Transfer 0.5 mL of the prepared medium to each well of the plate using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Return the plate to the cell culture incubator (37°C, 5% CO2, humidified).
Warm LaSR Basal medium in a 37°C water bath for approximately 30 min.
Prepare a conical tube with 12 mL of LaSR Basal medium containing 50 ng/mL VEGF.
Aspirate the old medium via vacuum aspiration.
Transfer 0.5 mL of the prepared medium to each well using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Return the plate to the cell culture incubator (37°C, 5% CO2, humidified).
Warm Stemline II medium in a 37°C water bath for approximately 30 min on Day 4.
Prepare a conical tube with 12 mL of Stemline II medium containing 50 ng/mL VEGF and 10 μM SB431542.
Aspirate the old medium via vacuum aspiration.
Transfer 0.5 mL of the prepared medium to each well using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Return the plate to the cell culture incubator (37°C, 5% CO2, humidified).
Warm Stemline II medium in a 37°C water bath for approximately 30 min on Day 6.
Prepare a conical tube with 12 mL of Stemline II medium containing 50 ng/mL SCF and 50 ng/mL FLT3L.
Aspirate the old medium via vacuum aspiration.
Transfer 0.5 mL of the prepared medium to each well using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Return the plate to the cell culture incubator (37°C, 5% CO2, humidified).
Warm Stemline II medium in a 37°C water bath for approximately 30 minutes.
Prepare a conical tube with 12 mL of Stemline II medium containing 50 ng/mL SCF and 50 ng/mL FLT3L.
Aspirate the top half of the old medium using a P1000 pipette.
Transfer 0.5 mL of the prepared medium in each well of the plate using either a P1000 pipette or a 5 mL serological pipette, depending on cell conditions.
Return the plate to the cell culture incubator (37°C, 5% CO2, humidified).
Perform half-medium change every three days until day 18 or functional analysis.
Aspirate old medium from differentiated wells using a P1000 pipette.
Gently wash cells once with PBS solution.
Fix cells with 0.2 mL of 4% PFA solution at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Aspirate PFA solution from the wells using a P1000 pipette.
Wash fixed cells twice with 0.5 mL PBS.
Store fixed cells in PBS at 4°C for up to 2 weeks.
Add 200 μL blocking solution into each well using a P1000 pipette.
Incubate the wells for 1 hour at room temperature or 8–24 hours at 4°C.
Dilute primary antibody at a ratio of 1:50 to 1:100 in blocking solution.
Remove blocking solution from the wells using a P1000 pipette.
Add 200 μL diluted antibody solution to each well.
Incubate cell plate at room temperature for 1 hour or 4°C for 8–24 hours in dark.
Aspirate primary antibody solution using a P1000 pipette after incubation.
Gently wash cells with PBS solution twice.
Dilute appropriate secondary antibody in blocking solution at a ratio of 1:500 to 1:1,000 according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Add 200 μL diluted secondary antibody solution into the wells using a P1000 pipette.
Incubate at room temperature in dark for 0.5 h or at 4°C for 8–24 h.
Aspirate the secondary antibody solution with a P1000 pipette.
Gently wash the cells twice with PBS.
Add 200 μL of diluted 1 μg/mL Hoechst or DAPI solution to each well for nuclear staining.
Incubate the plate in the dark at room temperature for 5 min.
Aspirate the nuclear staining solution.
Gently wash the cells twice with PBS.
Use a P1000 pipette to add 500 μL of PBS solution to each well to avoid drying out.
Image stained cells in a fluorescence microscope by selecting desired emission filter and objective lens.
Take and save the images after focusing, locating, and centering the specimen.
Process the fluorescent images using Fiji/ImageJ or similar software according to the manufacturer's instruction.
Process images from different channels individually.
Merge processed images together.
Fix cells in 1% (wt/vol) PFA for 20 min.
Permeabilize fixed cells in ice cold 90% (vol/vol) methanol for half an hour.
Incubate attached cells with 0.5 mL/well Accutase for 5–10 min at 37°C.
Use a P1000 pipette to detach and singularize differentiated cells from the bottom.
Collect floating hematopoietic cells after day 6 using a P1000 pipette.
Filter collected cells through a 70 μm strainer sitting on a 15 or 50-mL conical tube.
Add equal volume of DMEM medium with 10% FBS to neutralize Accutase-dissociated cells.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant via vacuum aspiration.
Wash pelleted cells with Flow buffer-1 solution twice to remove dead cells.
Prepare 100 μL/sample of conjugated antibody solution at a ratio of 1:50 to 1:100 in Flow buffer-1.
Incubate the cell and antibody mixture at room temperature in dark for half an hour or 4°C for 4–24 h.
Add 2 mL Flow buffer-1 solution to each tube using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant via vacuum aspiration and wash the cell pellet once with 2 mL Flow buffer-1.
Aspirate the supernatant via vacuum aspiration, use a P1000 pipette to resuspend the cell pellet with 300 μL of Flow buffer-1.
Transfer the cell mixture into a 5 mL FACS round bottom tube via the cap filter for flow cytometry analysis.
Keep the prepared cells on ice until analysis.
Run prepared samples in a BD Accuri C6 Plus flow cytometer according to the manufacturer’s instruction.
Load the filtered sample for data acquisition.
Start and stop data acquisition.
Save the collected data as a .fcs file for further analysis.
Open the .fcs file in FlowJo or similar software.
Visualize and analyze collected flow data under FSC vs SSC plot.
Gate the live cell population and apply to desired channels (e.g., PE and APC).
Purify differentiated hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells using magnetic activated cell sorting (MACS).
Pipette differentiated day 12 to day 16 hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells about 10 times using a P1000 pipette.
Filter the cells through a 40 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube containing 5 mL of DMEM medium with 10% FBS.
Count the total cell number with a hemocytometer or automated cell counter.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant via vacuum aspiration.
Use 10 mL Flow buffer-1 solution to wash the cells.
Aspirate the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the cells at a concentration of 10^7 cells/100 μL in Flow buffer-1 solution.
Add 2 μL CD45-FITC antibody per 100 μL cell mixture and incubate in dark at room temperature for 30 min.
Add 2 mL Flow buffer-1 solution using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant via vacuum aspiration.
Resuspend the cell pellet with Flow buffer-1 at a concentration of 10^7 cells/100 μL.
Add EasySep™ FITC Positive Selection Cocktail at 10 μL per 100 μL cell solution.
Gently mix the cell and selection cocktail solution using a P1000 pipette.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Add magnetic nanoparticles at 5 μL per 100 μL of cell solution, mix well.
Incubate at room temperature for another 10 min.
Bring the cell suspension to a total volume of 2.5 mL with Flow buffer-1 solution using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Transfer into a 5-mL round-bottom flow tube.
Place the flow tube without cap in the magnet and set aside for 5 min.
Invert the magnet and flow tube, pouring off the supernatant fraction.
Leave inverted for 2–3 seconds before returning to upright position.
Remove the flow tube from the magnet, add 2.5 mL Flow buffer-1 solution using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Pipette up and down for 2–3 times to mix the cell suspension.
Place the flow tube without cap back in the magnet and set aside for 5 min.
Repeat steps involving magnetic separation two to three times.
Repeat step involving pouring off supernatant once more.
Remove the flow tube from the magnet and resuspend cells in appropriate medium for subsequent culture or other applications.
Thaw the complete MethoCult™ medium at room temperature for half an hour or overnight at 2°C–8°C.
Prepare a 12-well plate for CFU assay by marking sample wells in the center and fill all neighboring wells with 2 mL sterile water to keep assayed wells under an appropriate moisture environment.
Dilute the cells from step 16n with Stemline II medium at a concentration of 2 × 10^4 cells/mL.
Add 50 μL of prepared cell solution into 2 mL of thawed MethoCult™ medium.
Vortex the tube vigorously for at least 4 seconds to mix the content thoroughly.
Let stand for at least 5 minutes to allow bubbles to rise to the top.
Transfer cell-containing MethoCult™ medium into the prepared 12 well plate.
Use pipette tips to break any generated bubbles during medium transfer.
Distribute the medium evenly across the surface of each well.
Rotate the plate gently to ensure the MethoCult™ medium attaches to all sides of the well walls.
Return the plate to a tissue-culture incubator set at 37°C, 5% CO2, and humidified conditions.
Incubate for 16 days.
Image and count CFU colonies under a microscope with magnification of 10× or 20× after the incubation period.
Prepare fresh culture media with Stemline II, 50 ng/mL SCF, 50 ng/mL FLT3L, and different small molecules (750 nM SR-1, 250 nM UM171, 0.5 μM BIO, 5 μM TEPA, and 1 μM GW9962).
Seed 2 × 10^5 hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells from step 16n per well of a 24-well plate in 1 mL Stemline II medium with different small molecules.
Resuspend cells from step 16n in 2 mL culture medium at a density of 4 × 10^5 cells/well for the 12-well plate.
Perform half-medium change with small molecule-containing Stemline II medium every 3 days.
After a 2-week expansion, gently pipette the cells up and down.
Collect all the cells.
Run flow cytometry analysis according to step 15 with CD34 and CD44 or other conjugated antibodies.
Count the total number of CD34+ HSPCs.
